notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.5 (5/7)
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that prevented online play in certain user environments (environments where an error occurs when receiving packets larger than 1472 bytes).

notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.4 (4/8)
notes.content:
The room name displayed in the LOBBY LIST during online play used to be just the host name, but it is now possible to set a canned text.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172057/10dfbc997174f8e5aa0ba5d7585e480d2f80cb42.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.3 (2/21)
notes.content:
When a guest leaves in online play, the guest can choose whether to leave immediately or when the current play is over.
When a guest leaves immediately in online play, the guest can wait a little bit to be able to leave with other players.

notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.2 (1/14)
notes.content:
- Visualization of how many people each client is participating with during online play
- Additional remedy treatment that comes up if you keep dying in the 15-3 shooting level

notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.1 for Mac OS(1/14)
notes.content: - Fixed: Steam overlay is not displayed on Mac

notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.1 (12/06)
notes.content: Dark green (dark) has been added to the background color for those who do not like bright colors.

notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.0 (11/28)
notes.content: You can now select a hat on the SELECT COLOR screen to make it fashionable!

notes.title: Update Ver 1.0.9 (11/15)
notes.content:
- Partial translation correction in French
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update Ver 1.0.8 (10/31)
notes.content:
- Brown is added to the PICO CAT color variation.
- The volume, player number, and background color can now be changed during gameplay.
- In online play, when viewing the PUBLIC room list, the WORLD or DARK level being played is now displayed.
- In online play, the PRIVATE room number can now be copied and pasted when entering the room number.
- In online play, Host can now kick guest even during level selection scr

notes.title: Update Ver 1.0.7 (10/22)
notes.content:
[Behavior change]
- End roll when clearing WORLD can be skipped after the second time.

[Level Adjustment]
- DARK4-4:A little gentler.

This is basically the last time we will be adjusting levels. We apologize for having to adjust the levels so many times since the release.
Basically, the difficulty level has become gentler than the initial levels. We are considering an initial difficulty option in the future. If you are interested in how the initial stages were, please wait until then.

notes.title: Update Ver 1.0.6 (10/10)
notes.content:
[Behavior change]
Fixed so that gun bullets can be fired even when approaching a wall or another character
WORLD 7-3、15-2:the blinking will stop and the shutter will come down from above. Also, the ON/OFF of the shutter will be manual instead of automatic.

[Level Adjustment]
WORLD11-4:A little gentler (changed to a shared life system)
DARK3-4:A little gentler when there are more than 5 players.

[Remedy]
WORLD6-4, 15-3 Power-up items now appear after a certain number of failed attempts
No need to take power-up items.

notes.title: Bugfix 9/27
notes.content:
Version up to 1.0.5. For cross-play, other platforms must also be 1.0.5 to be able to match.

[Bugfix]
- JUMPING BATTLE that did not result in a draw, even though it was a draw under certain conditions.

[Level adjustment]
- WORLD 13-2 allow for a 3% or less deviation in the graph

notes.title: [Temporary update] Color change of lights ON/OFF in WORLD 7-3 and WORLD 15-2
notes.content:
We changed it so that when it goes out of sight, it fades to the background color instead of going dark.
This may have alleviated the blinking. However, this is only a temporary fix.

Eventually, the blinking will stop and the shutter will come down from above. Also, the ON/OFF of the shutter will be manual instead of automatic. So you will be able to aim for the fastest clearing without being able to see it.

notes.title: Bugfix 9/17 (Mac with M2)
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused some M2-equipped Macs to freeze simply by losing focus on a window.
